mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, conditions near Badger Ridge Middle School are overcast with a temperature of 49 degrees. The overnight low will reach 45 degrees, and thankfully, no rain is predicted. It is a First Quarter moon phase tonight.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the 2027 budget. Additionally, the Public Works Department is reminding residents to dispose of fats, oils, and grease in the trash rather than down the drain to prevent sewer backups and environmental pollution.

Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to trivia nights at The Bogey Factory and Hop Haus Brewing, plus ART House 360 events.
In a report covering November 1 through November 15, on November 4, a 34-year-old woman was arrested for O W I following a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue.
Today's flavor at Culver's is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:00 PM tonight.
